issues.body:
### Environment
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1
- **Mod Loader:** NeoForge 21.1.259
- **Entity Culling Version:** `entityculling-neoforge-1.11.3-mc1.21.1.jar`
- **Sodium Version:** `sodium-neoforge-0.8.13+mc1.21.1`
- **Operating System:** Linux (CachyOS x86_64)

### Description
The game crashes upon rendering level terrain due to a `NullPointerException` when Entity Culling attempts to iterate through block entities during Sodium's chunk section preparation pipeline (`ClonedChunkSection.tryCopyBlockEntities`).

Sodium specifically catches this and points to an issue with Entity Culling's block entity iteration:
> `java.lang.RuntimeException: Failed to iterate block entities! This is *very likely* the fault of the Entity Culling mod, and cannot be fixed by Sodium.`

### Stack Trace
```text

See here for more details: [https://link.caffeinemc.net/help/sodium/mod-issue/entity-culling/gh-2985](https://link.caffeinemc.net/help/sodium/mod-issue/entity-culling/gh-2985)

### Files
- Log: [latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33547447/latest.log)
- Debug Log: [debug.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33547458/debug.log)

- Modlist: [Modlist.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33547538/Modlist.html)

## Notes
As far as I can tell, this has happened to other people before—issues have already been opened regarding it—yet it remains a persistent problem. In my case, it occurred on a dedicated server running locally; the server itself did not crash. The specific circumstances involved breaking a tree that was on fire due to the "Burn" mod—the top was burning, while the base remained as a regular log. I am also using the "HT's TreeChop" mod, and the issue occurred the moment I attempted to break the tree. I am willing to conduct further tests to help resolve this problem—hopefully, once and for all.

issues.title: [Bug] Entity Culling is ignoring it's Block Entity whitelist.
issues.body:
## What happened?
### Description

Using Entity Culling and Simply Tents, tents are being culled.  Moving around the tent will cull when close to the walls or a little bit past the halfway point of the tent.  Looking up while inside tent does not cull, but looking at the walls or down does.  Most noticeable in First Person, but does happen in Third Person as well.

Similar culling issue is happening to base Minecraft items selected in the "Skip Blockent." tab; Copper Golem Statue for example.  Statue is culled near top of its antenna.  Noticed in first person, and tilting view upwards.

Selecting all simplytents: keys in Entity Culling's "Skip Blockent." tab does not resolve.  Turning on "Force display culling" under General tab does not resolve.

Turning off "Block entity frustum culling" under General tab resolves issues.

### Steps to reproduce

Minimal setup: only Fabric API + Entitry Culling + Simply Tents + Geckolib + ModMenu in mods, and a fresh world.

1. Create new world.
2. Obtain a tent from Simply Tents, or a Copper Golem Statue from Minecraft.
3. Place item.
4. Move around, in/out of tent, and tilt camera view up/down to see culling happening and stopping.

### Expected behavior

Items should not be culled when relevant keys in "Skip Blockent." tab have been selected, regardless of frustum culling settings.
### Actual behavior

Items are being culled even when keys in "Skip Blockent." tab have been selected.

### Workarounds:

- Disable "Block entity frustum culling"

### Hypothesis

It would appear Entity Culling is ignoring it's own whitelist settings.  Changing selections in the "Skip Blockent." tab makes changes to "config\entityculling.json" file, but the functionality is being ignored.

## System and Client details:
### Minecraft Version

26.3
### Java Version

25
### Fabric Loader Version:

0.19.5-26.3
### Operating System

Windows 10 Home, 22H2 (OS Build 19045.7725), 64-bit
### What is your GPU?

NVidia GeForce RTX 3070 TI (driver 617.14 / Windows 32.0.16.1714)
### Mods used, and versions:

- Entity Culling - 1.11.2-26.3 - Fabric
- Fabric API - 0.161.0+26.3
- Geckolib - Fabric 26.3-5.5.7
- ModMenu - v21.0.0 for 26.3
- Simply Tents - 3.5-26.3-fabric

issues.title: [1.20.1 Bug] Crash on ticking 'summoned_sword_in' - NoClassDefFoundError: dev/tr7zw/entityculling/versionless/access/Cullable
issues.body:
The game crashes with a java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError when the entity efn:summoned_sword_in is ticked in-game. The crash occurs because CullableUtil.setAlwaysVisible directly references dev.tr7zw.entityculling.versionless.access.Cullable without a proper fallback or optional mod check when Entity Culling is absent or mismatched.

Environment:
- Minecraft Version: 1.20.1
- Forge Version: 47.4.10
- Mod Version: Epic Fight Nightfall 3.4.1

java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: dev/tr7zw/entityculling/versionless/access/Cullable
	at com.hm.efn.util.CullableUtil.setAlwaysVisible(CullableUtil.java:32)
	at com.hm.efn.entity.effect.SummonedSwordEntity_In.m_8119_(SummonedSwordEntity_In.java:175)
	at net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel.m_104639_(ClientLevel.java:274)
Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: dev.tr7zw.entityculling.versionless.access.Cullable

Steps to Reproduce:
- Summon or trigger the effect that spawns efn:summoned_sword_in.
- As soon as the entity attempts to tick/render, the game crashes to desktop.

issues.title: Entities near the edge of view "freeze" then fast-forward/catch-up on re-entering view — affects all movable entities, all dimensions
issues.body:
Summary

Any moving entity that passes near the edge of the rendered view (where EntityCulling starts culling it) visibly freezes in place, then rapidly "catches up" or fast-forwards through its missed movement once it's fully back in view. This happens with players, animals, iron golems, hostile mobs, and flying mobs (blazes/ghasts confirmed in the Nether) — it is not specific to any entity type or dimension. It matches the behavior reported in #326 (slimes moving erratically at screen edges), which appears to be the same underlying bug.

Root Cause

Two separate mechanisms in the mod both contribute to this, since culling happens on both the render side and the tick side:

1. Render-side: WorldRendererMixin#extractEntityRedir
When an entity is culled, this injection substitutes a fake, minimal EntityRenderState instead of the real extracted state, rather than using vanilla's own EntityRenderState.isInvisible flag (the same mechanism vanilla uses to skip rendering work for the Invisibility effect while still keeping the render state pipeline consistent). Substituting a stand-in state instead of marking the real one invisible creates a discontinuity in what gets fed to LevelRenderer.submit() while culled.

2. Tick-side: ClientWorldMixin#tickEntity / basicTick
This is the bigger contributor. When tick-culling is active, tickEntity diverts culled entities to a custom basicTick() instead of the entity's normal tick. That substitute correctly skips the expensive AI/pathfinding/physics work (which is the point of tick-culling), but it never calls entity.getInterpolation().interpolate().

In current vanilla (Entity#commonTick), that call is unconditional on the client side: if (level().isClientSide()) {
    getInterpolation().interpolate();
}

Position/rotation smoothing between server updates now runs through a queued/stepped system (InterpolationHandler / SteppedInterpolationHandler), not a per-tick lerp. interpolate() advances that queue by one step each tick. Since basicTick()'s substitute never calls it, the queue simply stops advancing while an entity is culled — the queued movement steps pile up. When the entity re-enters view and starts ticking normally again, the handler drains the entire backlog at once, which reads as a freeze followed by a fast-forward.

Because this is a single generic per-entity injection point (not mob-specific code), it affects every entity type equally and in every dimension — consistent with what's being reported.

Suggested Fix
extractEntityRedir: instead of substituting a fake EntityRenderState, use the real extracted state and mark it invisible (mirroring vanilla's own invisibility-based render skip), so the render pipeline stays continuous.
basicTick: add the same interpolation-advance call vanilla makes in commonTick, immediately after setOldPosAndRot(): if (entity.level().isClientSide()) {
    entity.getInterpolation().interpolate();
}

This keeps every other part of tick-culling's performance saving (skipped AI/pathfinding/physics work) fully intact — it's a one-line addition, not a change to the culling logic itself.

Testing

I patched both injection points along the lines above and tested across multiple mobs and multiple dimensions (players, iron golems, cats, rabbits, blazes and ghasts in the Nether). The freeze/fast-forward behavior no longer occurs for any of them

[entityculling-freeze-bug-fix.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32427760/entityculling-freeze-bug-fix.patch)

Entity Culling Version: 1.10.5
OS: Windows 11
CPU: AMD Ryzen 5
GPU: AMD Radeon

The screen becomes completely unresponsive and I cannot return to Windows normally. The only way I have found to recover is to put the PC into sleep mode using the physical sleep/power button and then wake it up again.

I tested my mods individually and found that Entity Culling is causing the issue.

Fullscreen → Windows key = PC freezes

bo$getOtherRenderer is from BadOptimizations:

https://github.com/imthosea/BadOptimizations/blob/5de4a3ad4299909178d8995dc0bc80626be48d44/common/src/main/java/me/thosea/badoptimizations/mixin/renderer/entity/MixinEntityRendererDispatcher.java#L39-L51

The handleOffThreadLayerAdd is from ModernFix:

https://github.com/coredex-source/ModernFix---mVUS/blob/420d70f5fb501a5a1ac6cee2ca096c2b91a52a9a/src/main/java/org/embeddedt/modernfix/common/mixin/safety/LivingEntityRendererMixin.java#L22-L34

The rest seems vanilla code and EntityCulling code.

The relevant versions are, MC 26.1.2, EntityCulling 1.10.5, ModernFix mVUS 5.27.19, BadOptimizations 2.4.1.

The error prints a few times right after you join a world and otherwise does not occur during gameplay again per my testing. It could be related to the ModernFix option "Dynamic entity renderers" but I have not tested this.

It seems like a possible fix would be to just do what ModernFix does inside within EntityCulling - doing a isSameThread check and calling mc.schedule otherwise, as seen in the [ModernFix mixin](https://github.com/coredex-source/ModernFix---mVUS/blob/420d70f5fb501a5a1ac6cee2ca096c2b91a52a9a/src/main/java/org/embeddedt/modernfix/common/mixin/safety/LivingEntityRendererMixin.java#L22-L34).

To clarify, this does not cause a crash and I just wanted to report in case it wasn't known. It seems ModernFix just prints the stacktrace so mod authors can fix it in their side instead of relying of ModernFix's mixin fix.

issues.title: Incorrect culling of CC: Tweaked monitors
issues.body: Entity Culling appears to incorrectly cull the display surface of CC: Tweaked monitors at certain viewing angles. The monitor frame remains visible, but the black display area (where the terminal output is rendered) disappears completely, making the monitor appear transparent inside the frame. ## To Reproduce 1. Install CC: Tweaked together with Entity Culling. 2. Place a monitor (both single and multiblock monitors are affected). 3. Move the camera until the lower-left monitor block (or the lower-left part of a multiblock monitor) leaves the camera frustum. ## Expected behavior The display surface should remain visible as long as the monitor itself is visible. ## Actual behavior The monitor frame remains rendered normally, but the entire display surface disappears. The monitor effectively becomes a hollow frame, as if the display quad had been culled. Through testing I found that this consistently happens once the lower-left monitor block (or the lower-left section of a multiblock monitor) leaves the camera frustum. The issue is especially noticeable with the default Minecraft FOV (70). It does not depend on: - monitor orientation (horizontal/vertical) - monitor facing direction The issue only occurs when Entity Culling is installed. ## Environment - Minecraft 26.2 - Fabric (loader - 0.19.3, Fabric API - 0.155.2+26.2) - Entity Culling: 1.10.5 - Sodium: **not installed** (the issue still occurs with Sodium) - Renderer: - OpenGL - Vulkan - OS: Arch Linux (Linux 7.1.4) - GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 - NVIDIA Open Kernel Driver 610.43.03 - Vulkan 1.4.341 - OpenGL 3.3.0 Since the issue only occurs with Entity Culling installed, I'm reporting it here as well. I've also opened an issue on the CC: Tweaked repository in case their custom renderer requires special handling.

issues.title: The license is problematic
issues.body:
Simply put, the license is vague and potentially unenforceable
Specifically:
1:
> The Software may not be used to get a) a commercial advantage, or b) monetary
compensation.

What is "a commercial advantage" or "monetary compensation" defined as? Can I call or modify the mod from another mod with commercial features? Could a paid or freemium client offer the mod as a download able? If I'm paid to make a modification of this mod that's redistributed free is that allowed? Can I host this on my own github page if I have a donations link on my main page?

2: This license seems to be derived from snippets of MIT, but all mentions of sublicensing and redistributing have been removed. So, I can modify it, but can I then redistribute it? Can I make a fork? Am I allowed to make a competing mod based on this code? Am I allowed to make a fork to fix a bug or contribute back? Am I allowed to make modifications but only for myself?

I'd recommend expanding on these 2 topics (maybe see how other licenses handle this) to be a lot more explicit in what is and is not allowed

Better yet, use a standard battle tested license like CC BY-NC-SA

issues.title: Crash when using visible-entities
issues.body:
Hi,
I am the developer of [visible-entities](https://github.com/ToBinio/visible-entities) and recently got a bug report about an incompatibility between `VisibleEntities` and `EntityCulling` - https://github.com/ToBinio/visible-entities/issues/9

Based on what I can see, the problem seems to caused by:

https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/blob/c35fa63c028de23de4a6555e72dc55310b167fde/src/main/java/dev/tr7zw/entityculling/mixin/WorldRendererMixin.java#L51-L52

My mod adds a custom `EntityRenderer` for interactions, including its own `RenderState`.
But `EntityCulling` does only create the default vanilla `EntityRenderState` which then crashes the game since the interaction's specific renderState was expected. 

Could this be fixed in someway?
Either by calling the `createRenderState()` if available or by not using an interaction?
If you have an idea how does could be fixed from my side, I would also love to hear that!

Tbh, I didn't yet have much time to look into your code, so I am unsure of what a possible solution would be

Thanks in advance!

issues.title: Fabric 1.21.9/10 renderNametagsThroughWalls not working + incompatibility with Armor Stands mod
issues.body:
In the update to 1.21.9, you made a change in your WorldRenderer mixin that effectively swapped all render states for culled entities with placeholder invisible armor stand ones, but this caused an incompatibility with my [Armor Stands mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-stands), in particular when it comes to name tag rendering for culled armor stands.

All other changes aside the `renderNametagsThroughWalls` config option doesn't seem to be checked anymore as of 1.21.9, making it non-functional.

However I suspect replacing all culled entities' render states with fake invisible armor stand ones will have other side effects with any mod that modifies entity rendering (like my Custom Paintings mod) but I haven't done enough testing to know. My mod is using info from inside the render state like the targeted entity and distance to camera to improve nametag rendering for armor stands, but even that is bypassed (and a little convoluted) i.e. when calling `entity.shouldShowName()` rather than `state.hasLabel(T, double)`.

For now as a workaround I'll be telling my users to disable culling armor stands entirely, but for some users they are actually a pretty significant performance hog so a better solution would definitely be ideal.

issues.title: Ad Astra compatibility on Forge 1.8.2 for MC 1.20.1

labels.name: Other Mod
labels.description: Issue created in combination with another mod

issues.body:
Running Ad Astra and Entity Culling causes the back half of the rocket to be culled while sitting inside the rocket, even when viewing it in third person. An easy fix is adding the lines

"ad_astra:tier_1_rocket",
    "ad_astra:tier_2_rocket",
    "ad_astra:tier_3_rocket",
    "ad_astra:tier_4_rocket"

to the config. 
Perhaps in a future update these can be added to the config by default just like the botania and create blocks present in the config already.

Edit: It appears I was mistaken. Adding these lines to the config does nothing, it only renders correctly at very specific third person camera angles. I tried adding the lines to both blockEntityWhitelist and entityWhitelist but no dice. So I guess this is now a bug report rather than a feature request.

issues.title: Does not cull block entities adjacent to a wall
issues.body:
Place chests against a wall.  
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d78f5105-6142-4c3b-a1e2-5f57b733569b)  

Then walk to the other side of the wall, and you'll notice that no block entities are culled.  
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb98eca5-9372-4337-a9ef-10cd78d377f4)  

You need to place an additional wall, then SOME of the chests get culled.  
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e31a7fb4-705b-4e28-b13b-6400be15b868)  

You have to get very close to the second wall to cull all 9 chests.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/26b2f27a-43ae-4032-9b99-d8e9101a5605)  
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7c167397-556e-44e6-a27a-adb92560d131)  

---  

I looked into the code, and there might be two issues causing these problems.

https://github.com/LogisticsCraft/OcclusionCulling/blob/7a346eabc5edcfdef31df3c21202c3c1473fb506/src/main/java/com/logisticscraft/occlusionculling/OcclusionCullingInstance.java#L58  
Using `floor` here instead of `ceil` might cause all AABBs to extend one block further than intended.  

https://github.com/LogisticsCraft/OcclusionCulling/blob/7a346eabc5edcfdef31df3c21202c3c1473fb506/src/main/java/com/logisticscraft/occlusionculling/OcclusionCullingInstance.java#L397  
The `allowWallClipping` check here likely prevents culling of block entities adjacent to a wall.

issues.title: display_entity bug when clipping is enabled
issues.body:
When you summon a block_display and enable clipping and teleport this entity while NOT looking at it, EntityCulling kinda looses track of it. When looking at the location this entity SHOULD be, it is invisible. When you turn around and look where it was BEFORE teleporting, it get's visible again

I tested this with entityculling-fabric-1.7.4-mc1.21.4, to reproduce use following commands:

 in command_block:
/summon minecraft:block_display ~ ~2 ~ {
  block_state: {"Name": "minecraft:oak_log"},
  transformation: { left_rotation:[0f,0f,0f,1f],right_rotation:[0f,0f,0f,1f],translation:[0f,0f,0f],scale:[5f,5f,5f]},
  width:0.1f,
  height:0.1f,
  teleport_duration: 3,
  Tags: ["DispBug"],
}

now move back and looking at it, enter /tp @e[tag=DispBug] ~ ~ ~

now do the same but turn around, move some blocks and enter /tp @e[tag=DispBug] ~ ~ ~
move back and while it should be visible, it only is when you look at the origin position

I can send a video of this id needed

issues.title: RenderNameTagEvent not being called
issues.body:
Using: Neoforge 1.21

Neoforge has a built in event (Forge as well) `RenderNameTagEvent` that gets called at `EntityRender#render()` before `EntityRender#renderNameTag()` gets called. For culled entities, this event gets skipped. The event should be called at either `EntityRendererMixin#shadowRenderNameTag()` or `WorldRendererMixin#renderEntity()` before the name tag gets rendered. 

This fix will enable my mod, *Hidden Names* to work properly with this mod. I'll be implementing a quick fix until this can be gotten to.

issues.title: Origins Compatibility
issues.body:
Hello! This mod really helps me with performance, but I have a bit of an issue when it comes to Origins compatibility!

The Origins mod has a power that lets you see entities through walls via the Glowing potion effect (however, it's applied locally). The problem lies in the fact EntityCulling stops rendering entities that exist through walls.

I think potential solutions could be:
- Adding a config option to blacklist all MOBS from culling, so I can continue to cull blockentities.
- Disabling mob culling when the glowing power is activated

You're able to read more about the power in question here: https://origins.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/power_types/entity_glow/#entity_glow

issues.title: Unclear Licensing
issues.body:
I was looking at the licensing of this project, and I am unsure what to follow.

https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/blob/1.18/LICENSE-EntityCulling says that I can distribute this software as long as I don't use it to get a commercial advantage or monetary compensation.

But looking at the README instead reveals that I am not allowed to distribute this at all, even if I created a derivative work.

So what really applies here?

issues.title: [Suggestion] Implement ExtensionPoint.DISPLAYTEST
issues.body:
Currently, the mod is required on both client and server or Forge will mark the connection as incompatible (and mod doesn't work on servers).

Forge allows registering an extension point to bypass this check, for mods that don't require both sides to be present.

See the docs here for 1.16.x: https://mcforge.readthedocs.io/en/1.16.x/concepts/sides/#writing-one-sided-mods

and here for 1.18.x syntax: https://mcforge.readthedocs.io/en/1.18.x/concepts/sides/#writing-one-sided-mods

issues.title: Culling conflict with Supplementaries' notice board
issues.body:
Heyo! I've found a conflict with this mod and Supplementaries, most likely caused by the culling from this mod. First to explain what the notice board does: You can place in a map to show it as if it was a painting on the wall of the block (hopefully that explains it properly). I'm guessing that the culling misses where the notice boards display entity is and derenders it.

**The issue:** Essentially it does not show when looking at it straight on and you must look around the side of the notice board blocks to see them properly. I've let the Supplementaries mod author know so both of you are informed of the conflict in case you wish to look into it.

issues.title: [1.16.5-1.18] RenderBoundingBox of BlockEntity is ignored for culling
issues.body:
Right now EntityCulling considers the render bounding box of any BlockEntity as a single block with AABB(0;0;0->1;1;1). [click](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/blob/b29646e3b34ed87da6ca3e3e574056250dd07363/src/main/java/dev/tr7zw/entityculling/CullTask.java#L84) This breaks the compatibility with some mods with blockentities which are rendered as multiblocks (where the one renders others). I have a mod called LootGames, which has the Minesweeper Minigame. The master block of this game which renders the whole game board is hidden in the corner under the walls. It has an infinite AABB for rendering purpose [[click](https://github.com/TimeConqueror/LootGames/blob/ae4348c0c0604e6637b8541b6975117d63574002/src/main/java/ru/timeconqueror/lootgames/api/block/tile/BoardGameMasterTile.java#L56)], so it needs to be rendered wherever the player is.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25156941/146097165-bc6af896-83f0-42d6-9daf-0e141e2d36f7.png)

issues.title: Culling breaks Botania mana burst rendering
issues.body:
Mana bursts are spawned inside mana spreaders, which makes them get instantly culled. Because they get culled, they no longer move on the client side, which makes them invisible to the client. (The bursts render purely through particles spawned on the clientside)

The entity id is `botania:mana_burst`, if you want to whitelist them by default.

issues.title: Crash on game startup
issues.body:
Version 1.3.3 causes my game to crash instantly on startup on Fabric 1.17.1.
```
[23:35:18] [Render thread/FATAL]: Mixin apply failed entityculling.mixins.json:ClientWorldMixin -> net.minecraft.class_638: org.spongepowered.asm.mixin.injection.throwables.InvalidInjectionException Critical injection failure: @Inject annotation on tickEntity could not find any targets matching 'tickNonPassenger' in net.minecraft.class_638.
```
I **think** this is because the `entityculling.mixins.json` file is saying the refmap is `entityculling.refmap.json`, when in the jar it's actually named `EntityCulling-Fabric-refmap.json`.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35247379/136682457-5932afeb-3a40-40e3-be12-221497e3f7b4.png)

Using:
* AdoptOpenJDK 16.0.1
* MC 1.17.1
* Fabric Loader 0.11.6
* Fabric API 0.36.1
* EntityCulling 1.3.3

issues.title: Minor issue with Furnace Minecarts
issues.body:
I've noticed an issue with furnaces minecart... They don't render when they get outside your line of sight. So if you are being pushed by them, they will eventually become invisible, until you look back at the exactly the same place they were before disappearing. To show the problem, I [uploaded a video showcasing it](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ytCSS1zt7aE)

The biggest issue with this bug is that if I don't know where were the last point where I saw the furnace minecart, it will remain invisible, somewhere in the rail line. So, it could be a very problematic issue in long rail lines, specially if the user is trying to transport a great number of villagers, for example.

issues.title: Minecarts Culling incorrectly (Visual Bug)
issues.body:
when minecarts in a loop (like a supersmelter) go off-screen, they never reappear when they should be coming back in view, this is only a visual bug.

Steps to reproduce:
1. create a minecart loop that can go off-screen
2. look at only half the loop, or at least enough so that the minecart can go off-screen
3. the minecart will not come back in the visible part of the loop, even though it should

mod version: `EntityCulling-Fabric-1.3.2`

issues.title: Conflict or poor optimization.
issues.body:
I often used the mystic staff of explosive mana condensation, but if you add this mod.
When using the mystic staff of condensation of explosive mana or the scroll of Rho ​​Aias from Mahou Tsukai, the fps drops to 1 and there is ~ 600 ms per tick
However, the Mahoujin Projector does not affect the FPS.
Item from botany that also very much squander FPS shard of Laputa(during operation, a ray of mana is created for each raised block).
Setting the number of particles does not affect the lags or has little effect.
These are just the items that I have checked, possibly others that create a lot of moving particles can lead to lags.
If you remove entityculling then fps does not drop when using mystic staff of explosive mana condensation.
![01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/81447418/112734410-9eda5400-8f56-11eb-8351-d5577f600cf5.jpg)
